title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-20
lineage: Cassette Master (Sony TC-K677ES) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Clean MSG soundboard captures a high‑energy set with a smoking Shakedown Street and solid second‑set gems like Scarlet/Fire, Terrapin, The Other One and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean sound and the lively crowd ambience that comes from an MSG show, making it a very listenable tape. Musically the band delivers a inspired first set highlighted by a 12‑minute Shakedown Street and rare Dupree’s Diamond Blues, while the second set builds momentum with big jams such as Scarlet/Fire, Truckin’ and The Other One, despite a brief sloppy moment in the Scarlet/Fire bridge.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review rates the show 4 stars, noting strong performances and clean sound; weighted estimate yields a high‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is described as pretty clean with just the right crowd electricity; no major dropouts or distortion noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set mixes upbeat jams with rare gems; second set starts strong and maintains momentum, ending with a solid back half of classics.

band_member_comments.Jerry: 12 minutes of inspired guitar work highlighted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals described as staggered during Shakedown Street.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s vocals noted but no specific comment on keyboard playing.
